key_findings: Tumor cell implantation increased GTP-Rac1 and p-PAK1 in spinal dorsal horn neurons, correlating with bone cancer pain.
Intrathecal NSC23766 reduced pain behavior and reversed dendritic spine and excitatory synapse remodeling of WDR neurons.
